intro: Del Taco is the California-born Mexican fast-food chain that mixes tacos, burritos and quesadillas with one thing no other taco chain has: crinkle-cut fries, including the Queso Loaded Fries. The lineup runs from The Del Taco and the value menu to the big Epic Burritos, the Crunchtada tostada and real ice cream shakes. Below is the full Del Taco menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: The Del Taco is about $2.79, a Bean & Cheese Burrito is $2.99, and an Epic Burrito runs $6.99 to $8.89. Crinkle-cut fries are $2.99 medium, Queso Loaded Fries are $4.49, and a shake is $3.99. The value menu has tacos and quesadillas from $1.29. The Del Taco and the crinkle fries are the signatures. The Del Taco is about 300 calories.

faqs.q: What is Del Taco known for?
faqs.a: Del Taco is a Mexican fast-food chain known for pairing tacos, burritos and quesadillas with crinkle-cut fries, including Queso Loaded Fries. The signature items are The Del Taco, the big Epic Burritos and the Crunchtada tostada.

faqs.q: How much is a Del Taco?
faqs.a: The Del Taco is about $2.79, a soft taco is $1.89, and value-menu tacos start at $1.29. Epic Burritos run $6.99 to $8.89, and a Bean & Cheese Burrito is $2.99. The Real Deal$ value menu is the cheapest way to order.

Yes, and it is one of the few taco chains that does. Del Taco serves crinkle-cut fries (small to large) and the loaded version, Queso Loaded Fries, topped with queso. The fries are a signature part of the menu.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Del Taco?
faqs.a: The crunchy Del Taco is about 300 calories and the soft version about 290. A Bean & Cheese Burrito is around 510, the Crunchtada about 350, and Epic Burritos run 740 to 1,050 depending on the filling.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Del Taco?
faqs.a: The best known are The Del Taco, the Epic Burritos, the crinkle-cut fries, the Queso Loaded Fries, and the Crunchtada tostada.
